title: The Buffalo Bills’ Secret Sauce Might Be Josh Allen—or an Actual Sauce That Was Invented 6 Decades Ago
summary: Buffalo’s winning at football right now, but win or lose, a staple of any NFL watch party is the Buffalo wing. So who invented the spicy snack?

title: New Research Found This Cheap and Common Supplement Improves Brain Function
summary: You should generally be skeptical of people touting supplements online, but science says this one is cheap, safe, and great for brain function.

title: Kentucky Distillers Filled Nearly 1 Million Fewer Bourbon Barrels Last Year. Smaller Producers Could Pay the Price
summary: Distillers are cutting production as millions of barrels of bourbon pile up in warehouses. Experts disagree on whether the slowdown is temporary or a sign of a lasting shift in drinking habits.
